Kent Sports Academy offer shorts to aid your understanding with each section of the course. 

Personal Training level 3 will help you get into the fitness industry, we don’t shout out that doing this course will make you the worlds most elite trainer. You get to elite by hard work, experience, and more training courses. 

We help you get to where you want to be by being qualified as a safe and effective PT or Sport Massage therapist.
